overview: A secure web-based file sharing application where registered users upload, store, share, and download files encrypted with AES-256, with role-based access control, expiring share links, file integrity verification, and full audit logging.
features: Register, sign in, and sign out with role-based access
Upload files encrypted with AES-256-GCM in the browser
Share files via expiring secure links with view/download permissions
Verify file integrity with SHA-256 hashes on download
Full audit logging of security events
Admin dashboard for user, file, share, and security monitoring
